title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenhändler mit scharfer Schusswaffe unterwegs – Haftbefehl erlassen

extraction.summaryEn: Police observed a suspected drug dealer selling narcotics at S-Bahnhof Tempelhof; he was arrested at S-Bahnhof Hermannstraße and found carrying a firearm, ammunition, drugs and a knife. An arrest warrant was issued.
